stops.name: Alain Prost
stops.source: https://www.motorsportmagazine.com/archive/article/december-1986/15/formula-one-mexican-grand-prix-australian-grand-prix ('He came in as early as lap 32 for fresh rubber'); also https://www.motorsportmagazine.com/archive/article/july-2004/142/race-86-australian-gp/
stops.note: puncture after clipping Berger; 8 laps before his planned stop

notes: Piquet (#6) was called in for a precautionary tyre change 'soon after' Mansell's lap-64 tyre failure (Motor Sport Dec 1986; Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1986_Australian_Grand_Prix) but no source read gives the lap: STORYLINE GAP. Goodyear then judged a non-stop run possible and the other runners stayed out. Rosberg (#2) retired lap 63 (tyre delamination), Mansell (#5) lap 64 (left-rear tyre).
